objective: Define the canonical independent Risk Engine, deterministic Pre-Trade Firewall, provider-neutral OMS/execution, reconciliation, uncertainty handling and kill-switch architecture for NEXUS QUANT without setting production risk limits or connecting real accounts.
scope: Define SignalCandidate to Risk to Firewall to OMS to execution-adapter path
Define deterministic Pre-Trade Firewall checks and fail-closed behavior
Define stable intent IDs, idempotency and duplicate prevention
Define provider-neutral OMS order lifecycle/state machine
Define hierarchical kill switches and safe-mode behavior
out_of_scope: Set final numerical risk limits or sizing policy
Open broker/exchange accounts or create credentials
Enable Demo, Shadow, Live or Auto Trading
tests: Risk can reject/reduce/halt but cannot raise its own ceilings
Firewall is deterministic and final before OMS
ApprovedTradeIntent is provider-neutral and has stable idempotency identity
Uncertain submissions are never blindly replayed
Broker/exchange truth is reconciled before rerouting/retry where execution may have occurred
Cross-broker failover cannot duplicate uncertain orders
Execution credentials require least privilege and no withdrawal authority where supported
security_tests: Credential handles, not raw secrets, flow to execution
Shadow environment cannot produce live broker commands
Security/Operations may request halt but cannot increase risk limits
rollback: Revert P02-E architecture artifacts and state/catalog changes. No accounts, credentials, runtime adapters or orders are created.
definition_of_done: Risk authority and contracts are canonical
Task Catalog and Current State are reconciled
